budget_file.role: NOT consulted at training time: parameters come from this file; budget.py was only cross-checked (budget_crosscheck)

inputs.note: v2 measured sd_CRN at T=2e4 only; it is used for every T_train candidate (same convention as tests T-24b)

G_s_plan.status: planning estimate; the gate value comes from M-3 MDE_D,plan (REQ-S1-22); s=0.01 cells are conditional

warm.method: least-squares regression of the MLP output onto the best S_HW handwritten strategy on train seeds (train.warm_start_theta)

start_registration.chosen: not yet decided: NAIVE pilot (REQ-S1-20) decides, recorded in results/direction2/pilot_decision.json

totals.note: all cells incl. the conditional warm pilot and s=0.01 cells; spec 5.5 table: about 94.8 h mean / 132.4 h p95

cells.name: pilot_naive_cold

start.rule: REQ-S1-20: the pilot starts cold (theta=0)

train_seeds.schedule: REQ-OPT-03: block [g*n_S,(g+1)*n_S) mod 1000 of perm_k, perm_k = Random(9000+run_id).shuffle(range(1000))

est_per_run.basis: spec 5.5: G_gens*T_train*t_step + floor(G_gens/50)*t_val (v2.json run_time_lam256_T2e4_300gen.nS256_{mean,p95}.t_step_ms; validation.t_val_s); start-up not included

cells.notes: REQ-S1-20 learnability pilot; NAIVE = M3C with p=0 (env.anchor_config('NAIVE'))

pilot_eval.seeds: train and validation seeds only (REQ-S1-20; s1.require_pilot_seeds); no test seeds
pilot_eval.threshold: validation G >= 0.8 * G*_ref (G*_ref re-measured on validation seeds, expected about 0.28)

always_report_1.compare_with: best handwritten strategy on NAIVE chosen on validation (REQ-HW-02; reference dz=2.0, 0.2793)

cells.name: pilot_naive_warm

start.rule: REQ-S1-20: runs only if the cold pilot is below 0.8*G*_ref (validation); same budget
